description: Requirement markers that were already wrong when the gate started (see scripts/check-marker-companions.mjs). blocks: files with a marker block of more than 3 requirement IDs, with the sum of IDs over their over-limit blocks. unnamedCompanionLines: companion files with marker lines that do not name their scenario or code point. strsTestsInIntegration: test/integration files that hold @tests_req StRS markers (to be sorted into @accepts_req or removed), with their count. They may only shrink: lower an entry when its file improves (node scripts/check-marker-companions.mjs --update) and remove it once the file is clean. Never add a file or raise a number.
